evidence.detail: Admin archetypes page is still a mustache template with server-rendered HTML form

triage.notes: The page has complex POST-based interaction (queue assignment, archetype moves, rule editing) that would require building new React components and REST API endpoints before removing the mustache template. Scope is larger than 150 lines.
